proof_body:
by
  intro K _inst1 V _inst3 _inst4 _inst5 n i j t h ht
  exact
    by
      constructor
      · exact Matrix.det_transvection_of_ne i j h t
      · intro hz; apply ht; simpa [Matrix.transvection, h] using congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K => M i j) hz
target_source: ∀ {K : Type*} [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (t : K) (h : i ≠ j) (ht : t ≠ 0), (Matrix.transvection i j t).det = 1 ∧ Matrix.transvection i j t ≠ 1
